documents.content: Protocol v2. HTTP 200 confirms only that the bound order read succeeded. Callback creation follows the terminal COMPLETED transition, but event publication can be asynchronous. Correlate the event's order version to the current bound order and inspect a delivery attempt before attributing a missing callback to transport failure. Do not treat PROCESSING as a callback incident.

documents.content: Receiver acknowledgement v2. HTTP 202 means the receiver durably accepted an event into its queue; it does not mean the receiver completed business processing. Check the same event_id, delivery version, receiver state, accepted_at and processing SLA. A QUEUED event within SLA should be observed until the deadline. Only a matching queue record older than its trusted SLA supports asking the receiver operator to investigate. Never resend automatically.
